name: paymee T3 skill — Achiri TND payment gateway for tier upgrades
goal: Implement agents/achiri/paymee.ts — creates Paymee (paymee.tn) checkout URLs for Achiri free→paid tier upgrades. tnd_basic=9 TND/mo, tnd_premium=25 TND/mo. Mock mode when PAYMEE_API_KEY not set. Wire GET /upgrade endpoint into server.ts. This is the payment link backbone for Apr 25 alpha monetization.
rationale: Apr 25 Achiri alpha needs a payment path. Without a checkout URL generator, free users who hit their 50-message/day limit cannot upgrade. Paymee is the only Tunisian payment gateway that accepts TND without international card requirement. This unblocks the paid tier value proposition.
swarm: NOT USED — multi-file integration, direct write.

tasks.title: agents/achiri/paymee.ts — checkout URL generator
tasks.description: Export createCheckoutUrl(params: PaymeeParams): Promise<PaymeeResult>. PaymeeParams = { userId: string, tier: 'tnd_basic'|'tnd_premium', firstName?: string, lastName?: string, email?: string, phone?: string }. PaymeeResult = { checkout_url: string, order_id: string, amount_tnd: number, tier: string, mock: boolean }. Amount from config: tnd_basic=9, tnd_premium=25. Mock mode: PAYMEE_API_KEY not set → return mock URL. Real mode: POST to Paymee API v2. Also export getUpgradeMessage(tier, checkoutUrl, lang): string — localized upgrade prompt in ar/fr/en.

tasks.title: server.ts — wire GET /upgrade endpoint
tasks.description: Add GET /upgrade?tier=tnd_basic&userId=xxx route. Returns { checkout_url, order_id, amount_tnd, tier, mock }. Also: when limit_exceeded is returned from chat(), include upgrade_url in response body (call createCheckoutUrl internally). Small surgical edit to existing server.ts.

tasks.title: scripts/achiri/validate-paymee.ts — 5-check validation
tasks.description: Tests: (1) tnd_basic checkout URL generated (mock mode), amount=9; (2) tnd_premium checkout URL generated, amount=25; (3) order_id is unique per call (UUID); (4) getUpgradeMessage returns Arabic string for 'ar' lang; (5) GET /upgrade endpoint returns checkout_url (start server, hit endpoint, kill server). All 5 must PASS.
